createEditor.description: Mount an editor. options: doc, classes, extensions, placeholder, editable, onChange(json), onSlash(state|null), onTrigger(state|null), onNode(state|null), onSelection(state|null), onFocus(bool), onError(err), uploadImage(file). Instance: view, schema, pm, commands, exec, insertNode, setNodeAttrs, deleteSlash, getJSON, setJSON, getHTML, setHTML, focus, destroy.

createSchema.description: Zebflow's block schema: paragraph, heading 1-3, blockquote, code_block, horizontal_rule, image, bullet/ordered/todo lists; marks bold, italic, underline, strike, code, link; unknown_block/unknown_text/unknown_inline keepers; then each extension's nodes and marks (a name defined twice is an error).

adoptDocument.description: A stored document as the schema can hold it: nodes and marks it does not know become unknown_* nodes carrying the original.

restoreDocument.description: The inverse of adoptDocument: every unknown_* node back to what it was.

htmlToDocument.description: Parse an HTML body into a document through the schema (browser only).

EMPTY_DOC.description: The document a fresh editor starts with.

pm.description: The ProseMirror packages: EditorState, EditorView, Plugin, Schema, DOMParser, commands, inputrules, lists, history, keymap, dropcursor, gapcursor.
